title: request_received
description: The facts the message kind request_received (the receipt: we have your request) can use. A fact schema is the one definition of what a template of this kind may mention: the Console offers exactly these as placeholders and the checker refuses any other. Facts marked x_derived are worked out by the kind's fact builder in the product, not typed by anyone and not computed by the template.

x_kind.name: Request received (receipt)
triggers: A registration request is saved for the first time (registration_service.register, outcome created). Replays, honeypot hits and rejected requests send nothing.
x_kind.recipient: adhoc: the name and email on the request (the person has no individual record until identity review).

name.description: The requester's full name, first and last, as the receipt greets them.

confirmation_number.description: The confirmation number of the request.

completion_link.description: The address that opens the same request with their answers filled in. Present only for private requests that have a completion token; absent otherwise.
